caption: The drawing depicts two mechanical objects, both featuring circular and curved elements, positioned side by side with partial overlap. The object on the left is primarily silver or light gray in color, with ornate, engraved patterns along its curved arms, and a central round plate adorned with a decorative four-petal motif. The arms are symmetrically bent and terminate in metal loops, each holding a triangular ring at the bottom. The object on the right is darker, depicted in shades of muted blue-gray and black, and is less ornate than the one on the left. It also includes curved arms and a round central element, but with a plainer, industrial appearance. A short length of coiled thick golden wire or cord is affixed between upper components of the dark object. Both objects are drawn with fine lines and shading, giving a three-dimensional effect, and are set against a plain, tan or cream-colored background with no additional details or context.
